description: Product Highlights The magnetic 25cm level comes with block vials, shock-resistant end caps, and a solid aluminium body that withstand high stress and ensure a long service life at the jobsite. The anti-slip end-caps help to avoid any discrepancy in the reading and deliver additional stability during the task. The level is provided with magnified center vials, UV-resistant vial liquid, and metal vial rings that allow a precise and long-lasting visibility. Moreover, its unique front-view vial guarantees easy readability from multiple positions. Equipment & Application The 25cm level is magnetic and can be easily attached to metal surfaces.
